Thanks — looking forward to talking through this and getting started.

Hi David — thanks for reaching out and for the detailed brief. I’m very interested in this compliance dashboard project; your stack (React + Python/Flask) and core features are a great fit for my experience.

A few quick confirmations so I can prepare a proposal and timeline:
• Real-time monitoring: Will you provide streaming endpoints or a message broker (e.g., Kafka) for transaction data, or should I implement an ingest layer against your existing APIs?
• Auth & data security: Will NexGen provide auth/SSO details and data access credentials, or do you need me to design role-based auth and encryption-at-rest recommendations as part of the scope?
• Compliance specifics: Are there particular regulations (e.g., PCI, AML, OFAC) or reporting formats I should prioritize for the automated reports and audit logs?

Budget & timeline: $8,000 fixed for a 6-week timeline is feasible for an MVP with the features listed. If the project requires extensive data integrations, additional compliance certifications, or full security hardening, I’ll call those out in the proposal.

NDA & onboarding: I see the DocuSign NDA and the onboarding link in your message. I’m happy to sign the NDA and complete onboarding — please confirm if signing the DocuSign link (the one you shared) is the preferred route and whether the onboarding form requires any attachments (e.g., W9, ID). I’m ready to sign today once you confirm.

Kickoff call: I’d like a 20–30 minute call to go over data access, compliance priorities, and acceptance criteria. I’m available Mon–Thu next week between 10:00–13:00 CT and 15:00–18:00 CT. Tell me what works for you or propose an alternate time.

Thanks — excited to potentially work together on this. 

Best,
Jordan Mitchell
